headline: Local Tea Stall Owner Demands Trilateral Meeting with Neighbor and Stray Cat to Resolve 'Aggressive Meowing' Ceasefire
body:
"I have offered the cat a bowl of milk and my neighbor a packet of Marie biscuits, but they refuse to sit at the same plastic table to discuss the barking-meowing imbalance," said the local chai wallah, currently holding a ceremonial saucer as a gesture of goodwill.

"Honestly, I just want to drink my morning tea without having to sign a peace treaty or hear the tea seller explain why he needs a UN-style mediator to handle a territorial dispute over the pavement space," remarked a regular office commuter while nervously tapping his watch.

"If the tea seller gets to have a trilateral summit for his stall politics, I’m definitely going to demand a summit with my landlord and the local cable guy regarding the sudden disappearance of my cartoon channels," claimed a local engineering student clutching a remote control.

"The geopolitics of this stall are getting out of hand, especially since the stray cat has started bringing his own feline delegation, effectively turning our morning caffeine break into an international incident," noted a nearby street food vendor while wiping down his metal cart.

"I just wanted a cup of ginger tea, but now I’m being asked to act as a neutral observer to verify that the biscuits are being shared equally according to the Geneva Protocol of snack distribution," added a passing delivery rider who was visibly late for his next pickup.
caption: From international conflict to neighborhood tea stall drama, everyone is suddenly a diplomat today. Who knew a cup of tea required a trilateral ceasefire agreement? ☕️☮️ #Geopolitics #ChaiTalks #NeighborhoodDiplomacy #PeaceSummit (satire)
igHook: Tag the one friend who treats every minor argument like a high-stakes diplomatic summit.
imagePrompt: A close-up, photorealistic shot of two empty steel tea glasses sitting on a weathered, circular plastic table outside a small street-side stall, with a discarded biscuit packet nearby and a blurry street scene in the background.
